sources.query: SELECT INTEGRATION_ID, DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, LEDGER_ID, ALLOCATED_FLAG, CODE_TYPE, DETAIL_ID, FLEX_VALUE_ID, FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID, TREASURY_SYMBOL_ID, TREASURY_SYMBOL, FUND_VALUE, ALLOCATION_PERCENTAGE, PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_RPT_CODE, PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_RPT_DESC, SEGMENT1_LOW, SEGMENT1_HIGH, PRC_HDR_CHANGED_ON_DT, PRC_HDR_CHANGED_BY_ID, PRC_HDR_CREATED_ON_DT, PRC_HDR_CREATED_BY_ID, PRC_DTL_CHANGED_ON_DT, PRC_DTL_CHANGED_BY_ID, PRC_DTL_CREATED_ON_DT, PRC_DTL_CREATED_BY_ID, PRC_ALLOC_CHANGED_ON_DT, PRC_ALLOC_CHANGED_BY_ID, PRC_ALLOC_CREATED_ON_DT, PRC_ALLOC_CREATED_BY_ID, PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_RPT_KEY, PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_RPT_KEY_DESC, CFRS_TREASURY_SYMBOL, FILE_NAME FROM WC_PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_DS

-- NOTE: $$DATASOURCE_NUM_ID is an Informatica mapping parameter; resolve it to its actual value from the session parameter file before running this dataflow.
-- NOTE: the session-level SQL override ALSO applies an incremental filter (H.LAST_UPDATE_DATE > $$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE OR D.LAST_UPDATE_DATE > ... OR A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE > ...) that only controls WHEN a row is pulled into the target during a given run, not whether it permanently belongs there. This steady-state comparison intentionally omits that time-gated clause (assumes all applicable incremental runs have completed) but DOES include the static CODE_TYPE = 'R' filter below, which permanently determines row membership.
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(H.PRC_HEADER_ID) || '~' || TO_CHAR(D.PRC_DETAIL_ID) || '~' || TO_CHAR(A.PRC_ALLOC_ID) AS INTEGRATION_ID,
  $$DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AS DATASOURCE_NUM_ID,
  TO_CHAR(H.SET_OF_BOOKS_ID) AS LEDGER_ID,
  D.ALLOCATED_FLAG,
  H.CODE_TYPE,
  D.PRC_DETAIL_ID AS DETAIL_ID,
  D.FLEX_VALUE_ID,
  H.FLEX_VALUE_SET_ID,
  H.TREASURY_SYMBOL_ID,
  H.TREASURY_SYMBOL,
  H.FUND_VALUE,
  A.PERCENTAGE AS ALLOCATION_PERCENTAGE,
  CASE WHEN D.ALLOCATED_FLAG = 'Y' THEN A.PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_RPT_CODE ELSE TO_CHAR(D.REPORTING_CODE) END AS PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_RPT_CODE,
  CASE WHEN D.ALLOCATED_FLAG = 'Y' THEN A.PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_RPT_DESC ELSE D.REPORTING_DESC END AS PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_RPT_DESC,
  D.SEGMENT1_LOW,
  D.SEGMENT1_HIGH,
  H.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS PRC_HDR_CHANGED_ON_DT,
  TO_CHAR(H.LAST_UPDATED_BY) AS PRC_HDR_CHANGED_BY_ID,
  H.CREATION_DATE AS PRC_HDR_CREATED_ON_DT,
  TO_CHAR(H.CREATED_BY) AS PRC_HDR_CREATED_BY_ID,
  D.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS PRC_DTL_CHANGED_ON_DT,
  TO_CHAR(D.LAST_UPDATED_BY) AS PRC_DTL_CHANGED_BY_ID,
  D.CREATION_DATE AS PRC_DTL_CREATED_ON_DT,
  TO_CHAR(D.CREATED_BY) AS PRC_DTL_CREATED_BY_ID,
  A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS PRC_ALLOC_CHANGED_ON_DT,
  TO_CHAR(A.LAST_UPDATED_BY) AS PRC_ALLOC_CHANGED_BY_ID,
  A.CREATION_DATE AS PRC_ALLOC_CREATED_ON_DT,
  TO_CHAR(A.CREATED_BY) AS PRC_ALLOC_CREATED_BY_ID,
  A.PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_RPT_KEY,
  A.PROGRAM_ACTIVITY_RPT_KEY_DESC,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(35)) AS CFRS_TREASURY_SYMBOL,
  CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(500)) AS FILE_NAME
FROM FV_FACTS_PRC_HDR H
LEFT JOIN FV_FACTS_PRC_DTL D ON H.PRC_HEADER_ID = D.PRC_HEADER_ID
LEFT JOIN FV_DACT_PRC_ALLOCATION A ON D.PRC_DETAIL_ID = A.PRC_DETAIL_ID
WHERE H.CODE_TYPE = 'R'
